content: You cannot change your future, but you can change your habits, and surely your habits will change your future.
author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
sourceWork: Ignited Minds: Unleashing the Power Within India
explanation: Future success or failure is not a mysterious stroke of luck; it is the compounding daily result of micro-habits practiced quietly when no one is watching.
practicalInsight: Audit your daily morning and evening routines. Replace one draining, mindless habit with one constructive, energizing ritual starting today.
reflectionPrompt: Which daily habit of mine is quietly shaping the future I say I don't want?
